title: Goal Planning
content: Set goals that are specific, measurable, and time-bound. For example: 'Save ₱500,000 for emergency fund in 24 months.' Prices rise over time (often 3–5% per year in the PH), so when planning for a future amount use inflation-adjusted targets: target today × (1 + inflation rate)^years. PesoSense computes this for you and shows how much to save each month under different return scenarios.
